TopicBundle.description: Everything authored for one topic: topic row, note frontmatter, worked examples, diagnostics, questions, find-the-mistake, prompts, insight, sets and verification logs

Topic.description: Teachable topic: the unit of authoring and navigation; maps to >= 1 statement

SubjectId.description: Subject pack id: "maths" | "further-maths" | "science" | "english-language" | "english-literature" | another kebab-case id

Hardness.description: Bundle size: L lite, S standard, H hard (examiner-flagged)

ExternalRef.description: Outbound link to Corbettmaths, Bitesize, YouTube, a CCEA document, PhET, GeoGebra or a past-paper question (metadata only)

NoteFrontmatter.description: Frontmatter of note.mdx: the Sheet (must-be-able-to, how examined, traps), formula-sheet split, scope limits

WorkedExample.description: Step list with narrated decisions and the mark each step earns, plus a twin and faded versions

PaperContext.description: Which paper the item imitates: unit, paper 1/2, calculator, Booklet B, resources allowed

AnswerSpec.description: What the marker compares the learner's response against; discriminated on kind

Tolerance.description: How close a numeric answer must be: absolute, relative, decimal places, significant figures, a range, or exact

AlgebraForm.description: Required written form of an algebraic answer; "subject" = the spec's subject alone on one side and absent from the other

DiagnosticItem.description: Single-skill multiple-choice item; every distractor names a misconception

Question.description: Original exam-style or practice question with a CCEA-language mark scheme

MarkPoint.description: One line of the mark scheme in the subject's mark language

FindTheMistake.description: Plausible wrong working seeded from an examiner report: locate, name, fix

RetrievalPrompt.description: Atomic retrieval prompt scheduled by FSRS towards the unit's paper date

ExaminerInsight.description: Chief Examiner report findings for one topic, in our words, cited to series/unit/question

PracticeSet.description: Interleaved / SSDD / mixed set of existing items, shown without topic labels by default

VerificationLog.description: The "Checked" panel: every gate result for one item version, plus learner reports and their resolution
